title: Privacy policy
content:
This example site does not collect personal information. It exists to demonstrate how Blogger content is compiled into static pages.

Content files

Posts and pages are stored as JSON in the project. Anything you write into those files is part of the example and can be edited or removed locally.

Browser storage

Dashboard settings in the preview are stored in browser local storage. They are for demonstration only and do not modify the template or send data to a server.

External links

Links to documentation or project pages follow the privacy practices of those sites. Review their policies before relying on them for production content.
